_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.2.76 keeps Connect responsive when Windows cannot finish opening the Arduino port.

Serial opening and buffer reset run outside Qt and the serial mutex with a five-second deadline. Timeout or window close discards late connections and keeps hardware controls locked; pending opens block flash and application installation. All GUI reconnects share the firmware verification handshake. Startup and device snapshot/restore use bounded serial opening, preserving the protected firmware transaction.

SysID now reports short acquisition span, duplicate/reset timestamps and acquisition gaps separately. The rejected run's ten continuous samples covered only 0.180 seconds; this no longer appears as a generic clock discontinuity. Minimum duration, pulse separation, uncertainty and valve dwell gates are unchanged.

Both-branch fault-injection and release tests cover stalled opening, Qt heartbeat, late handles and normal connection. This update cannot repair a hung Windows USB driver. Bench repeats require a responding port; complete small-cuff data, matched pulse baseline and real second-PC fleet adoption remain pending. The measured sinusoid sweep still attenuates severely at higher frequencies. This release does not qualify a 1,000-device rollout.

Transient Windows sharing errors during atomic profile save are retried for up to 350 ms. Permanent locks preserve the prior profile and archive.

The automated GUI smoke harness now skips the calibration-folder button, preventing unwanted Explorer windows during verification.

Firmware, clinical preset control and accepted calibration values are unchanged.
